messages.BEGIN: Authenticated current initiator owner submits proposal and original receipts, not movement permission. Server verifies live topology, limits, no overlaps/cycles, and exact role/dependency payload.
messages.VERIFY: Server sends same immutable token/roles/roster/deadlines to every required owner.
messages.ACK: Only expected current owners may accept their own exact local rows and roles. Missing, refused, late or duplicate conflicting replies cannot commit.
messages.COMMIT: After every owner consents, exact original episode installs locally. No initial ACK grants movement.
messages.READY: Existing owner callback applies its own hold through sole cap writer and observes actual stationary pose; sends token/participant/phase-bound readiness.
messages.ROOM_OBSERVED: Executing rear participant reports measured displacement/hull room with exact native command/pose/phase; recipient independently rechecks local room before its leg.
messages.RELEASE: Either original participant owner or server invalidation may retire exact episode; newer orders/episodes remain protected.

execution_rules: No automatic priority to drive through another hull. Deterministic tie-breaking chooses proposed roles only; every actual owner must consent.
Observe both roots stationary for continuous5s with anchored poses; do not reinterpret authored STOP/HOLD, service, tactical reservations, players or external controllers as a jam to override.
Check whole roster before any command; issue only one dependency leaf reverse leg at a time. Moving rear traffic, missing support or any obstacle refuses.
Use native AI movement only. Native reverse is not proved by a negative forceSpeed, command acceptance, elapsed time or changed desired destination.
Observe negative forward velocity, rear displacement within approved corridor, bounded heading change, full-hull clearance and no damage. Abort a native U-turn or unsupported rear request.
Fresh rear/body/traffic checks retain authority throughout each native leg. Front movement cancels further backing; stop only exact owned leg and preserve safe route handback.
Do not release upstream dependency on report/timer alone; it independently observes sufficient physical room.
Interruption, feature disable, participant death/deletion/locality change, unrelated native commands, expired consent or changed role topology end execution. No reverse replay on migration.
Cleanup must retain exact deferred native-command and cap-baseline ownership; do not repeat known whole-subsystem-off lost-observer gap.
Cycles, fifth participant, dense discovery or unavailable consent retain ordinary safe waiting and explicit failure; never push, teleport, alter collision or ignore traffic.
